selection_method: correctness or security consequence before style
real findings across the frozen seven-app corpus
complete census when population is small
deterministic clustered sample when population exceeds twenty

rules.selection_reason: An ERROR rule combines eval, exec, safe evaluators, attribute resolution and frappe.call under one remote-code-execution claim.
Template execution is security-sensitive, but exploitability depends on template provenance and sandbox restrictions.
Shell execution is a high-consequence sink with a bounded current population.
An empty record selector can silently update every row, making this a state-corruption boundary rather than style guidance.
Ignoring a permission result can expose data, while boolean-expression usage must not be misclassified as ignored.
